seo.title: The Activator Letter
seo.description: One idea from the practice, written out properly, once a month. No sequences, no upsells, unsubscribe in one click.

hero.title: One letter a month. No noise.
hero.intro: One idea from the practice, written out properly and sent once a month. It is the same material I use in the room — occasionally something I have changed my mind about, which in my experience is the more interesting kind of letter.

items.title: Once a month
items.body: Not weekly, not whenever something occurs to me. One letter, at the start of the month.

items.title: One idea, properly
items.body: A single thing from the practice, written at enough length to actually be useful. Not tips.

items.title: No sequences
items.body: You will not be dropped into an automated funnel. Nothing gets sold to you between letters.

items.title: One click out
items.body: Unsubscribe is in every email and works immediately. Your address is never shared or sold.

samples.title: The kind of thing you’ll get
samples.intro: These went out as letters first. If they read like something you want in your inbox, sign up above.
